title: Price and quote review for jobs that do not cover shop overhead; teardown before fixed customer-pay quotes
methodology: 1736 ROs (16%) fell $355,820 short of direct cost + shop overhead ($88 per clocked hour) in 12 months; largest gaps: Interior & exterior detailing ($282,249), Paintless dent repair ($21,755), Paint protection (film, ceramic coating) ($10,680). Assume 40% recovered through minimum charges, package pricing and quote discipline.
assumptions: Customers accept minimum labour charges / revised quotes; goodwill discounts approved by the branch manager only.
kpis: Fully loaded profit per RO, unprofitable RO count, estimate-to-actual labour variance
data_status: SYNTHETIC - illustrative estimate for a fictional business
